tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gyis gnon pa'i tshe bdag nag po'i dbang chog snying gzer nag po'i dkyil chog khrag 'thung rol pa'i dga' ston gyi mtshams sbyor rin chen 'bar ba'i prog zhu zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ sna tshogs rnyogs bral chu la zla brnyan ltar// mos pa'i rjes song dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bzhin// gcig pu du mar shar ba lha yi 'phrul// 'gag med chu zla'i gar bsgyur de la 'dud// phyogs dus rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje// sgyu 'phrul rab bkrams 'das la snying po'i mchog /sgrub pa bka' brgyad las kyang yang snying sku'i// dkyil 'khor yangs por 'jug pa'i ching 'dir bri// de yang 'dir 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i smin dbang snying gzer nag po'i dkyil chog khrag 'thung rol pa'i dga' ston gyi dgongs don gsal ba'i chings mtshams sbyor ba la/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las sgrol te/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang dam pa thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gyis gnon pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug pa'i sta gon gyi rim pa la/ gzhung las/ slob dpon mtshan nyid de yi las// slob ma 'jug cing lha ngo bstan// dbang bskur ba bzhi spyi yi chings// zhes gsungs pa'i dang po slob dpon gyi mtshan dang de'i bgyi 'os/ yang de nyid las/ gnyis pa bsnyen dang sa chog dang*/ sta gon dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'o// zhes spyi khyab sdom dang*/ nang tshan du dbye ba la bsnyen pa kha gso/ sa chog la ni bsrung dang brtag /sa bla dbang bya chag chag 'dul// bam blangs pa'ang zhar las so// sta gon la'ang*/ dkyil 'khor rdzas bum lha dang ni// slob ma bam gyi sta gon ston// zhes gsungs pa'i sa chog sta gon la'ang*/ dkyil 'khor sta gon/ rdzas sta gon/ bum pa sta gon/ lha sta gon/ zhes gsungs pa'i slob dpon gyi bgyi 'os de dag ni gzhung nyid du 'thus pa bzhin sgrub pa sngon du song nas/ 'dir slob ma gzhug pa'i thabs la sta dngos gnyis kyi/ dang po sta gon ni/ gzhung las/

de nas yol bas der bcad la// khrus bskrad gsol drangs phyag bya gsol// spro bskyed nyan gdams sems gnyis sdom// sgrib bsal byin rlabs so shing dang*// khyor chu ku sha bsrung chos bshad// rmi lam brtag ste bco lnga'o// zhes gsungs pas/ sa bcad nang tshan dbye na dang po khrus bya ba/ gnyis pa bgegs bskrad pa/ zhar byung mtshams bcad pa/ gsum pa sgo bar gsol bar gdab pa/ bzhi pa las kyi slob dpon gyis yol ba'i nang du drangs pa/ lnga pa phyag byas rdo rje slob dpon chen por gsol ba 'debs pa/ drug pa spro ba skyed pa/ bdun pa nyan par gdams pa/ brgyad pa sems bskyed gnyis kyi sdom pa bzung ba/ dgu pa sgrib pa sbyang ba/ bcu pa byin gyis brlabs pa/ bcu gcig pa so shing 'dor ba/ bcu gnyis pa khyor chu sbyin pa/ bcu gsum pa ku sha gtad pa/ bcu bzhi pa bsrung ba 'dogs pa/ bco lnga pa chos bshad pa rnams las/ dang po ni/ rtsa 'phros ni slob dpon dang slob ma'i bar du yol bas bcad la/ slob ma'i grangs nges ni/ bya ba spyi rgyud kyi rtsa chings gsang ba spyi rgyud kyi rjes su 'brangs pas rgyud sde thams cad la 'geb pa'i grangs nges mdzad po dag mchis kyang*/ 'dir ni bya ba bye brag gi rgyud dam tshig gsum bkod dang rdor 'phreng dus 'khor sogs rgyud sde gong mar grangs nges mi dgos par bshad bzhin rang lugs phyag len ltar grangs gang rung la/ dang po khrus bya ba ni/ las bum gyi bum chu sbyin zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// nas/ shrī ye hūm̐ bar gyis khrus byas la gral du 'khod/ gnyis pa bgegs bskrad ni/ bgegs gtor yi ge gsum gyis brlabs la/ hūm̐/ yang gsang lha yi dur khrod gzhal yas 'dir/ sogs kyis bka' bsgo /gu gul gyis bdug /yungs thun gyis brab/ zhal bzhi pa'i sngags dang a+yai ring gnyis kyis bskrad/ de nas gzhung gi sa bcad du mi gsal yang zhar shugs la 'thon par mtshams bcad pa ni/

'bar ba me/ mtshon cha 'chol ba/ khro bo 'chol ba/ gsang ba don dam bzhi'i mtshams gcod tshig don bzhin gsal 'debs par gyis shig /hūm̐/ gshin rje gshed po khros pa'i me// sogs dang*/ hūm̐/ steng yang mtshon cha'i bla re sogs dang*/ hūm̐/ dpa' bo bdud dgra bdud 'dul sogs dang*/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings rnam dag skye ba med pa'i dbyings sogs rang rang sngags bcas kyis bcad do/ /gsum pa gsol ba gdab pa la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig /khyed rang rnams dkyil 'khor gyi phyi sgo'i drung du 'khod pas sgo ba yab yum rnams la nang du gzhugs par gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum/ hūm̐/ mi shes 'khor bar 'khyams bsgral te// theg pa chen por 'god pa'i phyir// dpa' bo chen po dpa' byed can// ye shes sgo 'di bdag la phyes// lan gsum gsol/ bzhi pa drangs pa ni/ sgo bas phyi sgo phyes nas las kyi mkhan po'i phyag gi rdo rje la 'chang bzhin pa'i khrid pa'i mos pa gyis/ hūm̐/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang ba'i lam// 'di ni theg chen bla na med// gzungs 'phrengs rdo rje 'di la 'jus// thar pa'i lam mchog 'di la shog /ces stsal bzhin nang du khrid nas nang yol gyi rtsa bar bzhag par mos shig /lnga pa ni/ rang nyid slob dpon la phyag byas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// hoḥ ston pa'i sgron me bcom ldan 'das// lha dang slob dpon dgongs su gsol// dregs pa'i stobs kyis tshul bstan pa'i// brtul zhugs dam pa bdag la stsol// zhes lan gsum gdabs/ drug pa ni/ spro bskyed dang nyan par gdams pa sa bcad gong 'og du gsungs kyang 'khrugs sdeb phyag len du mdzad par 'dug phyir/ nyan par gdams pa ni/ 'gro ba sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i ched du rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba smin byed zab mo gsan nas lam nyams su len par bgyi'o snyam pas nyan dgos te/

ji skad du/ rtogs pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni// shin tu bsam pa bzang po ldan pas nyon// brjed nges blo la rdo rje sems sogs pa// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlobs// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ nyan pa'i tshul yang*/ rgyud las/ kha sbub zhabs rdol dri ma can// snod gsum skyon ni spang gyis la// rtse gcig g.yo med nyan par gyis// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ nyan pa'i phan yon ni/ rnam bshad rig pa las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos nyan pa la phan yon lnga gsung ste/ lnga gang zhe na/ ma thos pa thos par 'gyur ba dang*// thos pa yongs su byang bar 'gyur ba dang*/ som nyi spangs pa dang*/ lta ba drang por byed pa dang*/ shes rab kyi tshig dang don zab mo rtogs par 'gyur ba'o// zhes gsung la/ thos dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ thos pas chos rnams shes par 'gyur// thos pas sdig las ldog par 'gyur// thos pas mya ngan 'das pa thob// ces gsungs so// bdun pa ni/ de ltar nyan par bskul nas gang nyan na/ smin lam zab mo 'di'i tshul te/ de la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen po mnga' ba de nyid kyis sems can rnams kyi bsam pa dang*/ dbang po dang*/ skal pa'i khyad par mthun pa'i chos tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa thams cad kyang theg pa gsum du 'du ba las/ 'di theg pa chen po de la'ang rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa gnyis las/ 'di 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa ste/ rgyud las/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon pa// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi// cho ga zab mo 'di mkhyen pas// dpa' bo byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes// gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med des// skyob pa shākya seṅge yis// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i// dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom// zhes gsungs so*// gsang sngags kyi spyod pa yang rnam pa bzhi ste/

bya ba dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ rnal 'byor dang*/ rnal 'byor bla med do// bla med de la yang*/ ma hā yo ga /a nu yo ga /a ti yo ga gsum du yod pa las/ 'di rdzogs pa chen po a ti ltar nyams su len pa 'di la yang*/ dmod pa'i las rnam pa gsum las/ drag sngags gnam thog chen po'i sbyor ba/ de la yang las kyi mtha'/ tshe bdag srog bdag 'chi bdag gsum las/ 'di tshe bdag /de yang lhun gyis grub pa'i tshe bdag /phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i tshe bdag /phyag rgya gcig pa'i tshe bdag /sprul pa'i tshe bdag /las kyi tshe bdag dang lnga yod pa las/ 'di phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i tshe bdag zhes bya ba yin no// lung las/ dbang bskur dkyil 'khor sngon 'gro bar// rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa ste// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dkyil 'khor sngon du 'gro ba can yin la/ dkyil 'khor der yang dbye na/ rang bzhin ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor/ sprul pa sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor/ rig pa nyams kyi dkyil 'khor dang gsum gsungs pa ni/ 'phags pa rnams kyi spyod yul yin zhing*/ ting nge 'dzin la brtan pa rjes mthun tsam thob pa la sogs pa'i slob dpon gyis gdul bya'i dbang po la dpag nas/ dbang rab bla ma'i lus dkyil bstan pa/ 'bring tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor/ tha ma ras bris/ yang mtha' 'jug pa la rdul tshon te rnam pa bzhi las/ dam lam ras bris la brten nas/ rdul tshon nam ras bris sam tshom bu la brten nas dbang bskur bar mdzad pa'i tshul skabs su babs pa'i phyag len te/ rdul tshon ltar na/ sa chog sta gon bya ba dang*/ zhes pas nub dang po sa chog dang*/ gnyis pa sta gon/ ras bris ltar na/ nub dang po sta gon gyi cho ga dang*/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor nub dang po'am skabs de nyid du bsgrubs pa ste/ de la'ang gsum gyi lha dang bum pa'i sta gon sngon du song bas/ da ni slob ma sta gon gyi bya ba de sgrub pa la skabs su babs pa ste/

'dir yang sngon nas dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa'i slob ma gsar pa ltar na dkyil 'khor du 'jug rung min brtag phyir sta gon zhag chod sngon du dgos la/ de ma yin pa'i slob mtshan sta gon gyis brtag pa 'di 'jug rung du bgyis nas/ dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas dbang rdzogs pa rnams la ni sta dngos sbrel nas gnang ba las zhag chod mi dgos par dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams gdul bya 'dul byed du so sor bstan pa tsam ma gtogs par don chos kyi dbyings su thams cad ye shes kyi rol pa gcig pa'i phyir/ chos rnams thams cad rkyen bzhin du// 'dun pa'i rtse la rab tu gnas// zhes gsungs pas mtshon mdo rgyud du ma las thams cad bsam pa'i rang gzugs yin par lan du mar gsung bzhin da lta bod dang bod chen du bzhugs pa'i bshad sgrub kyi grub mtha' ris med thams cad kyis sbrel gnang mdzad par snang bas 'dir yang rmi lam brtags pa sogs 'dun pa sgom yang chog pa la/ mi chog pa ltar na zhag chod kyang song ba tsam gyis mi chog par rmi lam sogs ltas mtshan dman par shar tshe sbyin bsregs sogs spog chog ma bgyis par 'jug tu mi rung yang de tsam mi gzhib par zhag chod mtshon pa tsam mdzad pa'ang 'dun pa rdzogs byed tsam du zad do// zhes nas nges par zhag chod mi dgos pa'i dbang du byas sam/ zhag chod byed na/ dang po phyag len 'bring po mi nyams pa'i phyir sta gon zhag chod du sngon du gtong ba/ dkyil 'khor chen por rim 'jug bya ba'i skal ba mchog la longs su spyod pa skabs su babs pas mchog tu spro ba skyed cig /brgyad pa sems bskyed kyi sdom pa gnyis len pa'i/ sngon du 'jug pa sems bskyed ni/ khyed rnams 'di phyi rang don zhi bde'i ched du ma yin par mchog gi dngos grub sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid mi slob pa'i zung 'jug thob par byas nas sems can gyi don rgya chen po bsgrub pa'i phyir dang po thun mong du smon pa sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig

/dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// nas/ mdzad du gsol bar lan gsum/ gnyis pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor chen po dang*// rang byin brlab pa'i thabs shes la brten nas// bde bar gshegs pa'i dngos grub thob bya'i phyir// kun rdzob don dam byang chub sems bzung ngo*// oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ā dra u pa da ya mi/ lan gsum/ rigs lnga'i sdom pa 'di yis blangs/ zhes pas rigs lnga'i sdom pa len pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ rnam rtog ye shes lngar gyur pas// rtag tu bsten cing spyad par bya// rgyal ba rigs lnga'i brtul zhugs dag /srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ngo*/ /lan gsum/ dgu pa sgrib pa sbyongs ba ni/ rigs kyi gtso bo bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal zil gnon rtsal gyi yi ge brgya pa 'di lan gsum du bzla ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ yang lan 'ga' zhig bzla bar gyis shig /oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa mā ya sogs yig brgya lan 'ga' bzlas su bcug go /bcu pa byin gyis rlobs pa la/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod cig /khyed rang skad cig gis khro bo'i rgyal po 'jam dpal zil gnon du gsal ba'i sgo gsum so so la sngags kyi rgyas gdabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dpral bar dri'i thig le byas la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ mgrin par dri'i thig le byas la sngags thog mtha' 'dra bar/ wāk+ka badz+ra bcug /snying khar dri'i thig le byas la/ tsit+ta badz+ra bcug /de'i sngags don ni phyag 'tshal de bzhin gshegs sku rdo rje'i bdag nyid nga'o// zhes pa'i 'gres kyis gsungs dang thugs rdo rje gsum gyi rgyas gdabs bzhin nga rgyal 'dzin par mdzod cig /da ni dngos grub kyi skal ba brtags pa la gnyis kyi dang po ni/ so shing dor ba ni/ mañdzi'i ra ba khru gang pa gru bzhi par ba byung lnga'i dri bzang byug pa tshom bu lnga pa 'jam dpal zil gnon chen po'i rigs lngar gsal ba la/

rigs kyi bdag por mos la/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i so shing 'o ma can sor bcu gnyis pa rtse mor me tog gi 'phreng ba bcings shing dris byug pa 'di rtsa ba rang gi so la drud cing dmod bor nas/ badz+ra hā sa haḥ zhes brjod bzhin dor cig / ces dor du gzhug /de lta'i so shing de yang gang la phog par dngos grub kyi pra brtags pa'i phyir te/ de ni dbus su zug na mchog ste rigs kun 'dus rgyal/ shar du zhi ba/ lhor rgyas pa/ nub tu dbang*/ byang du drag po/ mtshams su zhi rgyas la sogs pa'i thun mong ste/ de yang shar lhor zhi rgyas thun mong*/ de bzhin lho nub tu rgyas dbang*/ nub byang du dbang drag /byang shar du zhi drag thun mong*/ steng du mkha' spyod 'og tu sa spyod rnams 'grub pa yin pas nges par mdzod cig /'di rtags su babs pas so so'i gang la phog pa de rang rang gi 'phros babs su zungs shig /bcu gnyis pa khyor chu sbyin pa ni/ dri bzang gis sbag pa'i chu chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin gyi rgyun 'di hub gsum btung ba'i lhag ma rgyab tu dor bas sdig pa dang skal ba ngan pa thams cad dor ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha sarba dharmāḥsarba pā paṃ ni tsā s+ya bi shwa dha ya sarba bi kalpan+da a pa na ya hūm̐/

zhes brjod la sbyin/ bcu gsum pa ni/ ku sha sbyin pa ste/ dhī dang hūm̐ las byung ba ku sha sngo ljang rtse mo ma nyam pa 'di dhīḥbazlas pa'i ku sha chung ba sngas dngahūm̐ bzlas pa'i ku sha che ba stan du rmi lam bag chags kyis mi 'khrugs par byed pa'i nus ldan du sbyin pa'o// badz+ra tik+ṣa ṇa baṃ/ ces brjod bzhin sbyin pas ku sha zhes pa bod skad du ngan sel zhes pa yin bzhin ltas ngan pa sel ba'i dgos pa'o// bcu bzhi pa srung skud ni/ skud pa sngo dmar bsrung bya'i lus tshad sum sgril rdo rje'i mdud pa sum brtsegs su byas par thugs kyi dzab bzlas btab pa las bum gyi chus bran la rdo rje rgya gram gyis rgyas gdab bzhin du khyed rang rnams kyi dpung pa g.yon du btags pas srung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ pho'i dpung g.yon dang bud med kyi dpung g.yas su bcings pa la las bum gyi chus bran la rdo rje rgya gram gyis rgyas gdab cing*/ e myags ya rngubs mug shag ka dun/ zhes brjod pas rmi lam bar chad kyis mi bsgrib pa'i dgos pa'o// bco lnga pa mi ldog pa'i phyir chos bshad pa ni/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams// u dum wā ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam la ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis sems can mnyam med don// mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus// bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang*// dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur bas na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i// tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos// skyobs pa'i gsang sngags bzlas nas ni// go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ zhes dpe dang bcas gsungs pa ltar u dum wa ra'i me tog 'char ba ni/ mun bskal dpag tu med pa re'i mtshams su sgron bskal re 'byung tshe/

sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byon pa dang me tog re 'char ba de bas kyang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos 'di dkon pa ni/ sangs rgyas byung ngo cog gis gsang sngags mi gsungs pas so// de ltar dkon pas rnyed par dka' ba dang*/ mjal zhing dkyil 'khor mthong ba tsam na bskal pa du ma'i sdig sgrib 'dag na/ der zhug cing dbang thob nas dbang don nyams su blang na srid pa las thar pa lta ci smos/ des na 'jug tu rung min brtag phyir bzhin bzang khyed cag bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su mgo bo ston la drag po'i dkyil 'khor du dbang zhu ba la mos gus chen po'i nyal nas dngos grub kyi mtshan ma bzang ngan rmi lam du brtag dgos te/ ji skad du/ bu kye ku sha'i sngas gdan la// mi smra dge ba'i sems kyis nyol// rmi lam mtshan ma gang mthong ba// nang par nga la smra bar gyis// zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ nam gyi cha stod bag chags 'khrul rmis dang*// gung thun bar chad dbang btsan gnyis mi nges/ cha smad tho rang sogs la bzang ngan 'char bar 'gyur bas legs par rtogs shig /bar chad du ma gyur na sang dkyil 'khor chen po mthong bar 'gyur ro// ces bsgo'o// dge ba bsngo ba la slob ma rang gnas su gtong*/ de nas slob dpon gyis dbang sgrub gzhung gi sa bcad drug pa bam chog kyang gzhung bzhin bsgrub pa dang rjes chog bya'o// ༈ //da ni dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la/ gzhung las/ gsum pa 'jug bstan dbab dang spyod/ zhes gsungs par/ gsum pa dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa/ lha ngo bstan pa/ lha dbab pa/ dbang la spyod pa dang bzhi ste/ de'i dang po ni/ yang gzhung las/ 'jug pa phyi nang phyi la yang*// khrus bskrad gsol drangs phyag bya gsol// spro bskyed nyan gdams sems gnyis sdom// zhes gsungs pas/ dang po phyi 'jug la yang*/ khrus gsol/ gnyis pa bgegs bskrad/ gsum pa sgo bar gsol gdab/ bzhi pa las slob kyis yol nang du drangs pa/

lnga pa rdo rje slob dpon la phyag bya ba/ drug pa gsol ba 'debs pa/ bdun pa spro ba bskyed pa/ brgyad pa nyan par gdams pa/ dgu pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sems bskyed kyi sdom pa khas len pa rnams yod pa las zhes nas sta dngos sbrel na phal cher sngon du song zhing*/ da cha nyan gdams spro bskyed kyi kha skong du/ slar yang chos skor 'di nyid kyi tshul cung zad spros pa ni/ zhes lo rgyus 'og 'dir 'byung ba 'chad pa man la rim pas 'jug /sta gon sngon du zhag chod par song rjes yin na/ snga nyin sta gon bgyis pa'i slob ma rnams tshang bar bsdus la yol rgyab tu 'khod cing*/ de rnams la/ skal bzang dag mdangs gsum nyal ba'i rmi lam tu rmis ltas gang ltar byung sgrib zol spang par bdag la smros shig / ces dris nas/ rmi lam der dge ba'i mtshan mthong na de la/ khyed rnams rmi lam sgyu ma'i nang tshan la zhen du mi gtub kyang*/ khar sang dkyil 'khor du dmod bor ba'i ltas kyis mi bslu phyir ltas de dag ni dkyil 'khor du 'jug par rung ba'i skal pa can du gyur lags pas de ring gi skabs su le lo g.yeng ba spang te yid shin tu bsgrim la nyams su blang na dkyil 'khor lha'i go 'phang thob par mi ring zhing*/ sangs rgyas pa'i lam byed du nye ba'o// zhes gzeng bstod/ ci yang ma mthong na 'bring zhing*/ ngan ltas byung na zhi drag gang 'os kyi sbyin sreg gam sgrib sbyong bgegs bskrad sogs gang 'tshams kyis bzlog pa'i thabs bya ba'am/ yang na kun kyang mnyam nyid bden med sgyu ma lta bur shes pas rgyas gdab pas thub bo// ngan ltas byung ba bsal nas de rnams la yang*/ khyed dag bar chad tu 'gyur pa'i ltas de rnams rgyal ba thabs la mkhas pa'i thugs rjes bzlog cing bsal ba'i spog chog 'di ltar bgyis pas da ni dkyil 'khor du 'jug par 'os pa'i rigs su gyur to// zhes ngal 'tsho bar byas la/

༈ da de ring gi skabs gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur ba skabs su babs pa las/ de yang 'jug pa/ bstan pa/ dbab pa/ dbang dngos dang bzhi yod pa'i phal cher khar sang sta gon gyi skabs su song zin kyang*/ gzhung las/ sta gon ji bzhin 'dir yang ngo*// zhes gsungs pas dang po 'jug pa phyi nang gnyis kyi/ dang po phyi 'jug la khrus gsol ba ni/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ gong gi sta gon gyi skabs bzhin/ khrus bgegs bskrad/ mtshams bcad/ gsol drangs phyag bya gsol ba yan sa bcad lnga pa song nas/ drug pa nyan gdams spro bskyed khar sang gi skabs su mdo tsam song rung*/ slar yang chos skor 'di nyid kyi tshul cung zad spro ba ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad 'khor sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral te bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi go 'phang la 'god par bya'o snyam pas ma yengs par gsan 'tshal/ de yang gnas phun sum tshogs pa'i klong*/ mtha' dbus bral ba'i pho brang rgya yongs su ma chad pa'i ye shes lhun gyis grub pa'i gzhal g.yas khang du/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa rdo rje 'chang chen po/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa rdo rje snying pos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ ye shes phun sum tshogs pa mi rtog pa'i dbyings las thugs rje chen pos rjes su chags pa'i skur bzhengs te/ dregs pa can dbang du bsdu ba dang*/ gdug pa can 'dul ba'i phyir phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs te/ chos phun sum tshogs pa gsang ba sngags kyi yang snying rtsa rgyud sdig pa snying 'dzin gyi chos skor yongs su tshang bar gsungs pa dang*/ chos skor de las byung ba ye shes khro bo sprul pa'i dgos ched kyang*/ sngon bskal pa dang po rdzogs ldan gyi dus su 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir bde ba'i dbang phyug ded dpon zhes bya ba rigs kyi bdag por grags pa gcig byung ba/

sngags kyi sgor zhugs kyang brda ma 'phrod bzod pa ma thob pas rigs ngan dang 'grogs shing sha khrag rol pas sngags tshogs phra mo'i yon tan yod kyang stobs dang ldan phyir brtags pa'i khro bo yod par rlom pa de gsang ba sngags kyi bka' bsgo log pas/ dus ma yin par tshe yi dus byas/ rdo rje dmyal bar sdug bsngal myong ba'i mthar rdzu 'phrul gyis lus blang te gshin yul 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba'i lcags mkhar bcu drug pa 'obs bcu gnyis dang ldan pa thod mkhar chen po'i pho brang du las kyi gshin rje nag por gyur nas 'jig rten phung bar byas pa'i tshe/ rgyal ba kun gyi thugs brgyud nas bka' bgros te/ sprul pa sna tshogs bkye bas sku 'khor sprul nas 'thab kyang ma thub pas/ rgyal ba kun gyis slar yang khyad par khro bo sme ba brtsegs par bsngags pas de'i thugs las ye shes kyi me sras mchog ya ma rā dza sprul te gshin rje nag po de'i dmar nag tsit+ta'i dkyil du zhugs te gzer btab ste rgyal ba rigs lnga'i gtso bo spyi'i gzugs can/ zil gnon phyag rgya chen por bzhengs te 'khor bcas gdan du mnan pas/ de dag gis khas blangs pa ni/ rdzu 'phrul rmad byung ngo mtshar che// bdag cag rgyal ba'i 'khor bgyid pas// srog dang ma phral bran du zhog /ci bcol las rnams bka' la nyan// zhes zhus par/ zil gnon chen pos bka' stsal pa/ nga yi bsgo ba'i las rnams kyis// sangs rgyas bka' 'khor srung la skyob// bstan pa 'jig na dregs pas sgrol// rnal 'byor can gyi 'phrin las gyis// bstan 'gro'i dpal du ci smon pa// 'bad med yid bzhin sgrub par gyis// zhes pa bzhin/ rten brten pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por bsgyur ba yin la/ de lta'i sprul rgyud kyi chos skor 'di ni bka' gter gnyis las gter ma/ de yang sba ba'i gnas bsrung ni/ sngon tshe gshin yul dme nag tu gshin rje'i bla mtsho gting khol klong du/

'chi bdag gshin rje nag po kha gdang glog phreng dang*/ bdud mo khrag ral ma khyo shugs kyis srid gsum za bar byed pa de la bu gsum byung ba mi sdug pa'i sprul pa sna tshogs bkye ba/ dug gi sdig pa nag po dang*/ bswe yi sdig pa dmar po/ lcags kyi sdig pa sngon po gsum byung bas 'jig rten phung bar byas tshe/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po khro bo'i skur bzhengs te zil gyis mnan dbang du bsdus nas phyag rgya chen po zil mnon rngams pa'i skus de rnams kyi srog gi snying po 'phrog ste bka'i bstan pa bsrung phyir 'chi bdag srog bdag tshe bdag gsum du sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa yin la/ de ltar sdig pa gsum las lcags kyi sdig pa sngon po'i lus la gnam lcags sdig pa'i chos skor thams cad tshang bar sbas pa/ lho phyogs dug mtsho khol ma'i gling du gnas pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyis sras mchog ya ma rā dza bskul/ sras mchog ya ma rā tsas dregs pa phyag na rdo rje bskul te/ lcags kyi sdig pa sngon po'i lus las 'jam dpal khro bo'i chos skor rdzogs par blangs ba las rim par 'phros pa las/ de yang lho phyogs dug mtsho khol ma'i gling du lcags kyi sdig pa chen po yod cing de'i lus la 'jam dpal khro bo'i chos skor tshang bar yod pa de long la shog cig zhes gsungs pa bzhin byon te lcags kyi sdig par gsungs pas/ dang po med ces gab pas phyag na rdo rjes mngon par shes pas gzigs kyang rjes su sdig pa nyid kyis kyang phul ba de las rim par 'phros pa las lcags sdig gi skor zhes pa dang*/ rjes su bod kyi yul du gnubs ban chen po sangs rgyas ye shes kyis rgyas par phyes pa lcags 'dra zhes pa'i chos skor gnyis su yod pa las dam lam gzhung bsdus pa/ lcags sdig gi chos skor zhes grags/ de yang lcags sdig khams lnga'i mdangs las bum chog mu tig 'phreng ba byung ba dang*/

mchu yi rtse mo las sdig pa nag po'i skye rgyud/ lus po mthing nag las rtsa rgyud sdig pa snying 'dzin/ mgo bo gru gsum las sgrub thabs snying gzer nag po/ de la sgrol ma rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum ste gnam lcags 'phrul gyi lde'u mig /ur mo gyang 'gyel las bzhi lcags sdig gtan la phab pa/ brdung ba'i rwa gnyis las ur mo bzhi/ blta ba'i mig gnyis las bka' 'byed gser gyi lde mig /rgyab stod gnyer ma gsum las sgrub thabs zhal gdams che 'bring chung gsum/ smad kyi gnyer ma gsum las bstod bskul che 'bring chung gsum/ bar gyi gnyer ma gsum las mngon rtogs che 'bring chung gsum/ yan lag drug las lcags sdig nag po'i gtor bzlog /bskang ba dam rdzas bam bskang*/ g.yas kyi yan lag las gnam lcags ur mo las bzhi/ g.yon gyi yan lag las ur mo mnan pa'i las/ bu ga brgyad las dmar len srog gi spu gri'i yi ge /stod dril nyi ma shar ba las byang chub sgrub pa'i chos sde/ bar gyi sgal tshig las gnam lcags ur mo'i chos sde/ smad kyi dug gi rtsa ba las mtshon cha las sbyor dug 'khor/ smad kyi snod rnams las gces pa'i 'khor lo bcu gsum ste/ tri ka rin chen 'phreng ba/ gzhang kha tshil gyi 'khor lo las gtad bzlog nang 'gras 'khor lo/ rgyu ma khug pa pa ring mo las/ byas pa bshig pa'i 'khor lo/ grod pa snod bzhi'i rdzing bu las/ bsad bzlog sbrag pa'i 'khor lo/ mtsher pa rgya zor khug pa las/ man ngag gser gyi yang zhun/ zhe sdang khros pa'i chu rgyus las/ sbrul nag rwa can 'khor lo/ gsang ba mjug ma ring mo las stong bzlog so mtshams gcod pa'i bsam gtan srid pa'i mchod rten/ mkhris pa dwangs ma'i mdzod phug las/ gnam lcags so bdar 'khor lo/ g.yas nas rgyu ba'i rkyang ma las/ bshig pa gnod sbyin mdze thod/ g.yon nas rgyu ba'i ro ma las/ mnan pa ri rab stobs chen/ srog rtsa dwangs ma dkar po las ur mo so 'debs 'khor lo/

don snod rtsa las chad pa'i chos sde ṭik+ka rin chen phreng ba/ rnam shes snying gi pho brang las sngags byang snye ma dkar mo/ glo ba las lag len don sdebs chen mo/ mchin pa las sngon 'gro gnad kyi las rim/ mkhal ma las rab gnas ye shes zung 'jug /mtsher pa las byung ba'i man ngag thams cad kyi rtsa ba lde mig rin chen 'phrul gyi sgo 'byed zhes bya ba man ngag gser gyi yang zhun sgron ma drug gi rtsa ba/ zil gnon tshe bdag nag po'i 'phrin las 'bring po/ sgom khog zhal gdams gnad kyi ṭik+ka zab pa'i mthar thug /g.yu spyang bcu bzhi/ drag sngags spu gri gcig dril/ 'khor lo bco brgyad kyi dpe'u ris sogs las tshogs mang du yod pa las/ 'di ni dkyil 'khor chen por smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba ste/ de la'ang rgyas 'bring bsdus pa'i rnam grangs mang ba las/ 'dir rgyas pa sgrub dkyil du dbang bskur ba'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon/ des rgya nag bkra shis khri sgor 'khrungs pa shrī seng ha la/ de nas rim bzhin shan+tiṃ gar+bha/ bal po'i rgyal po ba su dhā ra/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes/ gter ston rgya zhang khrom/ des gter du bzhes pa nas bka' gter gnyis ka tshang yang gtso bor gter ma pad lugs dang gnubs lugs gnyis/ de yang lcags sdig gzhung la gsal ba'i yi ge bsdus 'bring*/ o rgyan rin po ches mdzad pa rgyas pa ni/ sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa de dang don du gcig /de yang o rgyan rin po ches mdzad pa snga ma dang*/ sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa phyi ma yin/ de'i gter gnyis rgya zhang khrom gyis bzhes pa las 'dir ni thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa'i bdag nyid chen po kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar pos gnubs lugs rjes 'brangs su mdzad pa'i dkyil chog khrag 'thung rol pa'i dga' ston du grags pa'i steng nas dbang bskur ba las 'dir ni rgyas pa gnubs lugs te/

'dir yang gzhung gter ma nyid dang*/ rjes su'ang kun mkhyen pad dkar gyis dkyil chog khrag 'thung rol pa'i dga' ston ches zab rgyas de'i gzhung gis dbang bskur ba yin/ de nas gter ston nyid nas brgyud rim ni/ lcags gtun chen po nag po chos grags/ gnubs ston bya bral mtshan can/ rdo rje rgyal po chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ gnubs chen gu ru mchog ldan/ mthu chen rgyal mtshan lhun grub/ des sras tshe bdag bkra shis/ de nas rim pa bzhin/ kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar po/ rje btsun ngag dbang bzang po/ rgyal ba dpag bsam dbang po/ yongs 'dzin kun dga' lhun grub/ des mi pham chos kyi dbang phyug 'jigs med rig pa 'dzin pa'i dpa' bo/ 'jam dpal dga' ba'i bshes gnyen rje dge legs bzhad pa/ ngag dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ grub mchog ngag dbang bde chen/ paṇa chen chos kyi nyi ma/ gsang bdag grub pa'i dpa' bo/ kun mkhyen sgrub brgyud nyi ma/ des rje rig pa 'dzin pa chos skyong mgon po/ khams sprul bstan pa'i nyi ma phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde/ kun mkhyen pad+ma dri med grub pa'i dbang po/ khyab bdag bla ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de'i bka' drin las bdag gis legs par thob pa'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa yin/ brgyud pa de ldan gyi smin dbang zab mo zhu ba sngon du 'gro ba sems gnyis sdom pa ste/ de la dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzad par zhu/ bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyi spyan sngar khyed rang rnams lam log pa las khyad par gyur pa'i skyabs 'gro dang*/ lam dman pa las khyad par 'phags pa'i theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed 'di gnyis med du mi rung phyir rgyun bshags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/

nas/ thugs kyi sras su mdzad du gsol/ bar lan gsum/ gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sems bskyed dang sdom pa len pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor chen po dang*/ sogs sngags bcas lan gsum/ rigs lnga'i sdom pa 'dis yis blang*/ zhes pas rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ rnam rtog ye shes lngar gyur pas// rtag tu bsten cing spyad par bya// rgyal ba rigs lnga'i brtul zhugs dag /srog gi phyir yang mi btang ngo*// ces lan gsum/ de ltar rnams kyis dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyi'i 'jug pa song nas/ gnyis pa nang 'jug la dbye na/ gdong g.yog pa/ maṇ+ḍal phul ba/ gsol ba gdab pa/ nang du drangs pa/ dri ba/ khas len pa dang drug gi /dang po sngar 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon chen po'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba mtshon pa'i phyir/ gdong g.yogs dmar po re 'ching bar mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas bcings/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas mos gus chen pos gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ hūm̐/ yang gsang gshed po'i dkyil 'khor du// bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal lags kyis// rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gtso// dpa' bos bdag la bka' drin stsol// lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab pa song nas/ gnyis pa nang du drangs ba la/ slob dpon bdag nyid kyis rdo rje gtad pa 'di la 'jus nas rim bzhin nang du drangs ba'i mos pa gyis/ hūm̐/ 'khor ba'i sems can ma lus kun/ rgyud lnga lam gyi sgo bcad de// mtho ris thar pa'i sgo phyes nas// bla med gnas su drangs bar bya// yol ba phyes/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ des nang du drangs pa song nas/ lnga pa dam tshig bsrung bar nus sam 'dri ba ni/ 'di ltar bya ba yin te/ de la rdo rje mgo bor bzhag nas/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod rnams// gsang ba'i dam tshig bsrung nus sam// bsgrub mchog brtul zhugs spyod nus sam// mngon spyod las rnams byed nus sam//

lan gsum/ de ltar bdag gis lan gsum du dris pa la/ dris lan/ khyed rang rnams kyis kyang dris lan du gyur pa 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol// khyod kyis bka' stsal bdag rjes sgrubs// dam tshig sdom pa gang yin dang*// gsang ba'i las kun bsgrub par 'tshal// brtul zhugs chen po bla med pa// mthar la phyin par spyod par 'tshal// 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i bya ba rnams// ji ltar gsungs pa nyan par 'tshal/ lan gsum/ des khas blangs pa ste/ de ltar rnams kyis dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa phyi nang song nas da rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa lha ngo bstan pa sogs la nang tshan du dbye na dgongs gsol/ phyogs bzhi'i sgo phye ba/ phyag bya ba/ lha bstan pa/ khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la byin gyis rlabs pa sogs/ yod pa'i dang po dgongs gsol ni/ slob dpon bdag gis dkyil 'khor gyi lhar gsol ba 'di ltar 'debs te/ lha dang rdo rje slob dpon mched// phyogs mtshams kun nas mkhyen pa'i dpal// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ des dkyil 'khor gyi lhar gsol gdab song nas/ sgo phye ba ni 'dir ltar ro/ /hoḥye shes rnam pa kun ldan zhing*// dur khrod chen po'i gzhal yas khang*// yul las 'das pa'i ye shes kyis// mkha' dbyings dag pa'i shar sgo phye// zhes pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i shar sgo shag gis bye bas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad khra lham mer mthong bar gyur pa'i mos pa gyis/ de nas phyag 'tshal la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gyis/ khyed rang rnams dkyil 'khor shar sgor zhugs te phyag 'tshal bar mos la 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ mnyam nyid dag pa'i tshul gyis phyag 'tshal lo// des phyag 'tshal ba song nas/ lha ngo bstan pa ni/ dkyil 'khor chen po 'di'i dbus su tshom bu'i bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa yab yum/ rtsa ba'i lha bzhi/

gyad gnon gyi lha brgyad/ sprul pa las gshin gsum/ yum drug /lo gshed pho mo nyer bzhi/ zla gshed bcu gnyis/ sbas ma'i ma bzhi/ zhag gshed so gnyis/ sgo ba gshed chen bzhi/ yum ro langs ma bzhi/ za ma'i gshin rje/ bka' nyan ji snyed pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa zhal mngon sum du hram mer bzhugs pa rnams la mos gus dungs par gyis shig /des lha ngo bstan pa song nas/ byin gyis rlabs pa la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gyis/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i mdzod spu'i dbus nas 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa na ra ra byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi smin mtshams su zhugs/ lus la thim pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i lus kyi sgrib pa thams cad bya sgro mes tshig pa ltar bsreg /mgul gyi dbus nas 'od zer dmar po dpag tu med pa na ra ra byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa nas zhugs/ ngag la thim/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag /thugs ka'i dbus nas 'od zer sngon po dpag tu med pa na ra ra byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga nas zhug /yid la thim/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas slar dkyil 'khor chen po'i lho sgor phyin pa'i mos pa dang bcas sgo phye ba ni/ hoḥ ye shes rnam pa kun ldan zhing*// zhes pa nas/ mkha' dbyings dag pa'i lho sgo phye// zhes pas dkyil 'khor chen po'i lho sgo/ sogs/ phyag 'tshal la= /khyed rang rnams dkyil 'khor lho sgor zhugs nas= /mnyam nyid= /des phyag 'tshal ba song nas/ dkyil 'khor chen po 'di'i zhes pa nas/ yid kyi sgrib pa thams cad dag par gyur pa'i mos pa gyis// zhes pa'i bar/ de nas nub sgor phyin pa'i zhes sogs/ byang dang bcas par 'don pa bcas phyogs bsgyur la sngar ltar 'gre'o/ /de ltar rnams kyi phyogs bzhi'i byin rlabs zhu ba song nas/ da ni rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa ye shes dbab pa la nang tshan du dbye na/ dang po dam tshig bsgrag pa gnyis/

yon gyi maṇ+ḍal/ gsol ba 'debs pa/ khyed rang rnams lhar bskyed pa/ ye shes pa dgug pa/ bstim pa/ sngags bzla me tog dor ba/ brtag pa/ lha bstim pa rnams kyi dang po la gnyis las phan yon nyes dmigs gnyis ka'i sgo nas mna' chu blud pa 'di lta ste/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ badz+ra yak+sha kro dha dza hūm̐ ṭha ṭha i dan+ta na ra kan/ des gnyis ka'i sgo nas mna' chu blud pa song nas/ gnyis pa slob dpon gyi bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rak+sha'i phreng ba mgo bor bkon par bya ste/ rigs kyi bu mchog rdo rje khyod// de ring phan chad nga yi bu// nga yis bsgo bar bya ba dang*// dam tshig la yang gnas par bgyi// dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mos gus chen pos gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa yis// chos dbyings ye shes pho brang nas// ye shes khro bo'i sprin chen po// ma lus bdag la dbab tu gsol// des gsol ba 'debs pa song nas/ de nas lha bskyed pa la dang por/ bum pa'i mgul gyi oṃ byang rnams khyed rang rnams so sor gtad pa'i tshe/ slob ma'i mgo bor bzhag /zhes gzhung nas gsungs te/ dang po nas slob ma ji snyed pa'i grangs de snyed pa'i oṃ byang gtso bo bum pa'i mgul du btags pa da lam so sor gtad rgyu yin na'ang*/ de ltar ma 'grub pas na/ da lam mtshon byed gcig 'di nyid mgo bor 'jog ste de la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gyis/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo 'jam dpal phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i thugs ka nas oṃ re khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor byon pa'i mos pa gyis/ hūm̐/ thig le'i ngo bo 'jam dpal sku// chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid// na ro rdo rje sems pa'i sku// me long ye shes ngo bo nyid// zla tshes pad+ma dbang gi sku// kun rtogs ye shes ngo bo nyid// 'a ni don yod grub pa'i sku// bya ba nan tan ngo bo nyid// u ni sangs rgyas bde gshegs sku// mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid// yig 'bru lnga yis byin brlabs pas// sku lnga ye shes ldan par shog

/oṃ de 'od du zhu nas khyed rang rnams kyi lus la zhugs pas/ lus mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rgyu dang rkyen med par nas/ dpal gyi chas kyis brgyan pa'o// zhes pa'i bar/ rgyu med ces sogs/ dreg pa kun gyi bskor bar e ring bsnyen pa'i man ngag ji bzhin brjod/ des khyed rang rnams dam tshig gi lhar bskyed pa song nas/ da ni brgyud pa'i bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug pa'i phyir gsol ba 'debs te/ de yang khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams tho brtsegs su bzhugs pa la mos gus chen pos gsol ba 'debs pa'i rim pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ chos kyi dbyings kyi gzhal yas nas// sogs gsol 'debs bya/ de nas/ bla ma rnams 'od du zhu nas mthar thams cad khyed rang rnams la thim pas byin rlabs ma lus pa thob pa'i mos pa gyis/ des brgyud pa'i bla ma'i byin rlabs zhu ba song nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i ye shes dbab pa la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gyis/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba'i thugs kar sa bon yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag /de las dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs/ sgra dang bcas pa'i 'od zer bla ma'i thugs kar phog /bla ma'i thugs ka nas lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrogs dril bu thogs pa'i pho nya spros te/ chos kyi dbyings drag po e yi gzhal yas khang nas/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa yab yum rtsa ba'i lha bzhi/ gyad gnon gyi lha brgyad/ sprul pa las gshin yab yum drug /lo gshed pho mo nyer bzhi/ zla gshed bcu gnyis/ sbas pa'i ma bzhi/ zhag gshed so gnyis/ sgo ba gshed chen bzhi/ yum ro lang ma bzhi/ za ma'i gshin rje bka' nyan ji snyed pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ hūm̐/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa'i sku/ sogs dang*/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes shes sems dpa'

sogs/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams kyi snying khar lcags kyus dzaḥ zhags pas hūm̐/ lcags sgrog gis bam̐/ dril bus hoḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar char pa bab pa bzhin du byon pa khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa gyis/ sku gsung thugs kyi sngags kyi mthar/ dz+nyā na a be sha ya āḥ zhes pa btag la drag tu bzla/ spos kyis bdug cing rol mo bsgrags/ gar dang brda skad 'phar sogs 'byung*/ des ye shes pa dbab pa sku gsung thugs kyi sngags bzla ba song nas/ me tog dor ba'i dang po rigs brtag pa ni/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i nang du gsung kyang phyag len maṇ+ḍal thog tu/ de yang dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams so sor snang ba tsam las don dam chos dbyings ye shes klong du gcig pas 'dir maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du zil gnon rigs lnga he ru ka'i sa bon rang mdog bris pa rang skal lha gang yin pa la 'bab par shog snyam pa'i mos pa gyis/ hūm̐/ bde chen rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du// rig pa'i me tog 'di dor bas// sngon tshe las 'phro yod pa'i lha// gang yin mchog la 'bab par shog / zhes pa'i smon lam dang bcas pas/ e ka ya ma mu dra traṃ puṣ+pe sa mā ya pū dza hoḥ zhes ltos pa med par me tog dor cig /slar de dngos grub kyi don du mgo bor bcings pa'i tshe/ gang la phog pa'i lha de nyid lus la thim pa'i mos pa gyis/ des me tog dor ba song nas/ de nas lha ngo sprad pa la dang po mig dar dbye ba/ dngos gzhi lha ngo sprod pa/ rjes su don dam pa'i rnam par dag pa gsum gyi dang por gsol ba gdab pa 'd-i'i rjes zlos gyis/ shin tu ma rig mun pa yis// bdag nyid long bar gyur pa las// 'jam dpal thugs rje chen po yis/ bdag gi mig 'di dbye ru gsol/ oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭa/ des gsol ba btab pa song nas/ mig dbye ba dngos ni mig thur thog pas dbye ste/

ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar// bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i// rab rib 'jam dpal bdag gis bsal/ tsak+ṣu pra be shag / ces mig dar phye/ des mig dbye ba song nas/ dngos gzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha ngo sprad pa ni/ de ring phan chad bu khyod kyis/ rtsol ba'i sems stobs las byung ba// dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ gzhan la gsang ba ma smra zhig /de nas lha ngo bstanapa la rgyas pa dkyil 'khor chen po'i mngon par rtogs pa phyi nang gsang ba'i dag sbyar bcas snang stong lha skur ngo sprad pa/ 'bring po rgyu mtshan rnam gzhag bcas grang nges zung 'jug ngo sprad/ bsdus pa mtshon bya dpe dang mtshon byed du don du bsdu ba gsum las dam lam phyi ma 'di ltar ngo sprad bsdu ba las/ gzhi chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i mkha' dbyings chos kyi 'byung gnas khyab gdal yangs pa chen po'i klong du gang 'dul sna tshogs der snang sku gnyis kyi cho 'phrul mi zad pa las/ 'byung brtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i lte bar pad+ma dur khrod rdo ra me ri'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar gzhal med kyi khang pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag dbus su ling tshe brgyad dbus dang dgu'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon yum gsum dang bcas pa ste rtsa ba'i lha bzhi/ phyogs bzhi'i ling tsher/ ya ma rā tsa sogs sras mchog bzhi/ mtshams su gshed chen bzhi ste gyad non lha brgyad/ chos 'byung phyi'i zla gam dmar po gsum du sprul pa gsum yum bcas te drug /de'i phyi'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis la lo gshed bcu gnyis/ yum bcas te yab yum nyer bzhi/ de'i phyi'i gru chad bzhi la gru chad re rer lha gsum re ste zla gshed bcu gnyis/ sbas pa'i ma bzhi bcas/

de'i phyi khyams 'obs so gnyis la zhag gshed so gnyis/ sgo bzhi gshed chen bzhi/ yum ro langs ma bzhi bcas te dkyil 'khor nang ma'i lha rnams dang*/ gzhan yang 'khor yug tu za ma'i gshin rje rnams/ mthar bka' nyan gyi 'khor tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa sgyu ma'i 'phrul 'khor mi zad pa'i rnam pa me long la pra phab pa bzhin snang la rang bzhin med pa'o// mngon sum du gsal thob mdzod/ gsum pa don dam pa'i rnam par dag pa'i bshad pa ni 'di lta ste/ ngo bo chos nyid spros pa dang bral bas na ka dag rnam pa rang byung gi ye shes las phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i dkyil 'khor rten brten pa dang bcas pa rang shar bas lhun grub/ de yang don bla na med pa'i sa la lhun gyis rdzogs pa dang*/ rtags kyi gdug pa can bsgral bar bstan pa ste/ yang dag par na don rtags gnyis su med pa'o// dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa nyid sbyor ba sna tshogs ma 'gags par spyod pani thugs rje ste hril gyis bsgril na/ ya gi 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po nas ma gi dkyil 'khor chen po'i dur khrod la gnas pa'i 'byung po'i bar rten dang bcas pa gzhi ma bcos pa de kho na nyid chos sku 'gyur ba med par gcig /sku mtshan ma'i gzugs su snang ba kun ni sgyu ma lhun grub ye shes longs spyod rdzogs par gcig /las sna tshogs so so nas 'dul ba ni sprul pa'i sku ru gcig ste/ de ltar sku gsum gyi gyi rol par rang rang gi don la spyod pa ni/ chos nyid la chos nyid rol/ ye shes la ye shes rol/ sprul pa la sprul par rol pa ste/ rgyud las kyang*/ ngo bo ma bcos chos kyi sku// chos sku 'gyur ba med par gcig /sku dang mtshan mar btags pa kun// ye shes lhun gyis grub pa'i sku/ las dang sbyor ba sna tshogs kun// sgyu ma lhun grub sprul pas 'dul// rol pa'i phyag rgyar snang ba'o// de ltar rnams kyis dkyil 'khor lha ngo bstan pa dang don dam gnas lugs bshad pa dag song ba ste/

de rnams kyis dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i sngon 'gro song nas/ dngos gzhi dbang la spyod pa la bzhi/ bum dbang phyi la bskur ba/ gsang dbang nang la bskur ba/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gsang bar bskur ba/ zhor du mtshan dbang dang*/ bla med dbang sogs te/ dang po bum dbang la/ bum pa/ cod pan/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ ming gi dbang stai rigs pa'i dbang lnga/ lha tshogs sku gsung thugs dbang dang drug ste de rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal/ de nas khyed rang rnams mos gus gdung ba dang bcas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ hūm̐/ khams gsum dbang du sdud pa dang*// srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa dang*// stong gsum yum du bsgrub pa'i phyir// dus gsum sangs rgyas dbang bskur stsol/ 'jam dpal gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du// bsnyen sgrub las la sbyar ba dang*// dkyil 'khor las mtha' bstan pa'i phyir// phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang bskur stsol// gshed bzhi sbyor ba 'khor lo dang*// ban dgra gsod dang bsgral ba dang*// phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa'i phyir// mthu rtsal dbang bskur stsal du gsol//

lan gsum/ des gsol ba gdab pa song nas/ dang po mi bskyod pa'i dbang la/ las kyi bum pa khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i rang bzhin gyis dbang bskur bas khyed rang rnams kyi sdig sgrib ma lus pa yongs su dag pa'i mos pa gyis/ hūm̐/ rin chen dngul gyi bum pa ni/ byang chub sems kyi chu yis bkang*// byang chub chu yis khrus byas pas/ nyon mongs bag chags byang gyur cig /oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho ྅haṃ/ de ltar khrus byas pas sdig sgrib thams cad dag par gyur pa'i mos pa gyis/ des phyi dri ma 'khrud par byed pa las kyi bum pa'i dbang bskur ba song nas/ zil gnon rat+na he ru ka'i dbang bskur ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gyis/ khyed rang rnams zil gnon rat+na he ru ka g.yas thod dbyug g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ yum khros ma mā ma ki tri shū la dang thod khrag 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba dpal chen po'i chas brgyad kyis brjid pa/ g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros sgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ /bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha yi thugs ka nas dbang gi lha rigs lnga yab yum/ sems dpa' sems ma/ khro bo khro mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ gshegs ma rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi lnga'i chus gang bas dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul/ khro bo dang khro mo'i rgyal mo rnams kyis bgegs skrod pa'i mos pa gyis/ hūm̐/ ngo bo mnyam nyid ye shes las/ rang bzhin yon tan lha ru gsal/ rnam pa bum chus dbang bskur bas/ rin chen rigs kyi dbang thob shog /oṃ e ka ya ma rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ rigs kyi bu khyed rnams la bum pa chu dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas nga rgyal rnam par dag nas rin po che'i rigs thams cad kyi dbang dang ldan te mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes thob par gyur cig

/des ye shes lha tshogs kyi byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa zil gnon rat+na he ru ka bum chus dbang bskur ba song nas/ da ni zil gnon pad+ma he ru ka dar dpyangs kyi dbang bskur ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gyis/ khyed rang rnams zil gnon pad+ma he ru ka dmar nag g.yas pad+ma g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ yum khros ma na bza' dkar mo tri shū la= /gshegs ma rnams kyis rin po che'i cod pan dar dpyangs kyi phur ma dang bcas pas dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis sogs/ hūm̐/ ngo bo sor rtogs ye shes las// rang bzhin gsung gi lha ru gsal// rnam pa cod pan dbang bskur bas// pad+ma rigs kyi dbang thob shog /oṃ e ka ya ma pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ rigs kyi bu khyed rnams la cod pan dar dpyangs dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas 'dod chags rnam par dag nas pad+ma rigs kyi dbang dang ldan te so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes thob par gyur cig /des gsang ba yon tan rgyas par byed pa zil gnon pad+ma he ru ka dar dpyangs kyis dbang bskur ba song nas/ zil gnon karma he ru ka dril bus dbang bskur ba dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gyis/ khyed rang rnams zil gnon karma he ru ka ljang nag g.yas ral gri/ g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ yum khros ma dam tshig sgrol ma tri shū= /gshegs ma rnams kyis dril bu sgra dang bcas pas dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis sogs/ hūm̐/ ngo bo bya grub ye shes las// rang bzhin phrin las lha ru gsal// rnam pa dril bus dbang bskur bas// las kyi rigs kyi dbang thob shog /oṃ e ka ya ma karma a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ rigs kyi bu khyed rnams la dril bu sgra dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas phrag dog rnam par dag nas las kyi dbang dang ldan te bya ba grub pa'i ye shes thob par gyur cig /des zil gnon karma he ru ka dril bus dbang bskur ba song nas/ slar yang zil gnon badz+ra he ru ka rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gyis/

khyed rang rnams zil gnon badz+ra he ru ka mthing nag g.yas rdo rje g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ yum rdo rje khros ma nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma tri shū= /gshegs ma rnams kyis rdo rje gsor ba dang bcas pas dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' sogs/ hūm̐/ ngo bo me long ye shes las// rang bzhin thugs kyi lha ru gsal// rnam pa rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas// rdo rje rigs kyi dbang thob shog /oṃ e ka ya ma badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ rigs kyi bu khyed rnams la rdo rje gsor ba dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas zhe sdang rnam par dag nas rdo rje'i rigs thams cad kyi dbang dang ldan te me long lta bu'i ye shes thob par gyur cig /des zil gnon badz+ra he ru ka rdo rjes dbang bskur ba song nas/ zil gnon bud+dhā he ru ka ming gis dbang bskur ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gyis/ khyed rang rnams zil gnon bud+dhā he ru ka smug nag g.yas 'khor lo g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ yum khros ma sangs rgyas spyan ma tri shū la dang thod khrag 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dpal chen po'i chas kyis brjid pa g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐ de las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i thugs ka nas dbang gi lha rigs lnga yab yum/ sems dpa' sems ma/ khro bo khro mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ gshegs ma rnams kyis ming 'di zhes bya bar 'bod pa dang bcas pas dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bkra shis brjod/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul/ khro bo dang khro mo'i rgyal mo rnams kyis bgegs skrod pa'i mos pa gyis/ hūm̐/ ngo bo chos dbyings ye shes las// rang bzhin sku yi lha ru gsal// rnam pa ming gi dbang bskur bas// chos dbyings ye shes thob par shog

/oṃ e ka ya ma bud+dhā a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ rigs kyi bu khyed rnams la ming 'bod pa dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas gti mug rnam par dag nas bde bar gshegs pa'i rigs thams cad kyi dbang dang ldan te/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes thob par gyur cig /de ni zil gnon bud+dhā he ru ka ming gi dbang bskur ba'o// rigs kyi bu khyed rnams la phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i sgo nas he ru ka lnga'i dbang bskur bas nyon mongs lnga gnas su dag /rig pa ye shes lnga'i dbang thob pas/ phung po lnga khrag 'thung rigs lngar gnas 'gyur ba'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no// de ltar rnams kyis rigs pa'i dbang lnga bskur ba song nas/ drug pa nus pa rdzogs par byed pa ye shes lha'i dbang bskur ba la gsum ste/ sku'i nus pa rdzogs par byed pa phyag rgya'i dbang dang*/ gsung gi nus pa skyed par byed pa sngags kyi dbang*/ thugs kyi nus pa ster bar byed pa phyag mtshan gyi dbang bskur ba'o// dang po la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gyis/ khyed rang gi phung khams skye mched mi dmigs pa stong pa'i ngang las rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo rgyu dang rkyen med par phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i 'jam dpal he ru ka /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi spyi/ khro bo'i rgyal po thams cad kyi gzugs kyi sku/ dug ha la ha la ltar mthing nag /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi pa/ yan lag rags shing gsus pa 'phyang ba/ g.yas zhal dkar la bzhad pa/ g.yon zhal dmar la chags pa/ dbus zhal mthing la rngam pa/ mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs shing ljags la khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khrug pa/ sma ra ag tshom smin pa skra thams cad kham ser/ spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzir nas bskal pa 'jig pa'i me spro ba/ khro gnyer bcings pa'i shangs kyis bu ga drug nas 'thor byed kyi rlung nag po 'tshubs pa/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na 'khor lo rdo rje ral gri/

g.yon pa gsum na be con gtun shing sdigs mdzub/ thod pa lnga yi cod pan/ bdud dang mu stegs dang srid pa gsum gyi bdag po thams cad bsgral ba'i mgo bo lnga bcu rtsa gcig dang snying sbrel ba'i rgyu ma'i ga sha/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul chen brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ glang po che'i ko ba rlon pa stod du gsol zhing*/ zhing chen gyis rked dkris pa/ khrag dang bcas pa'i stag lpags sham thabs su byas pa/ dpral bar thal chen gyi tshom bu/ mkhur tshos sna la rak+ta'i thig le/ brang gi 'dzoms su zhag gi sor ris rtse gsum gyi dbyibs su bris shing*/ rdo rje'i mtshon cha ngar ma'i gshog pa brgyangs pa/ yum be ta li mthing nag snying dang thod khrag 'dzin par snyom par 'jug pa/ g.yon brkyang nas 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrug pa'i klong na bzhugs par gyur/ 'byung ba'i dwangs ma bzhi gtso bo'i lha bzhi/ 'byung ba'i snyigs ma bzhi gyad gnon gyi lha bzhi/ dug gsum las gshin gsum/ nyon mongs pa bzhi gsang ba'i gshed bzhi/ rnam shes bzhi mon pa bdud bzhi/ sems byung gi rgyu ba zhag dang za gshed/ gnas skabs bzhi'i thig le sgo ba bzhi la sogs pa lus gdod ma nas phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por grub pa'i phyir/ ye nas yin pa la yin par shes par gyis shig /de nas pho brang nang na dkyil 'khor lha tshogs khra lam mer bzhugs pa rnams las rang 'dra ba chad de khyed rang rnams la gnyis su med par thim pas dregs pa sku'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa gyis shig / gtso bo'i tsaka li sogs rim pas mgo thog tu bzhag ste/ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings nas go 'byed gzugs phung dgrar/ nas/ bde gshegs khro bo'i tshogs rjes dbang bskur ro// zhes sogs de bzhin phrin las bstod pa'i phyag 'tshal tshab// dbang bskur ro zhes sbyar bas bskur/ yum dang rtsa dang gyad las gshin// gshed dang mon bdud zhag dang sgo// lhag ma thams cad gcig tu bya// rgyas 'dod re res bskur ba yin/

de ltar ye shes lha rnams kyi sku'i dbang bskur ba song nas/ slar yang rdo rje'i phyag rgyas dpral bar dri yi thig le byas pas dngos grub de nyid brtan par gyur pa'i thugs mos/ sku rdo rje'i dngos grub brtan par bya ba'i ched du dpral bar dri yi thig le bya ba yin te/ dpral bar rdo rjes dri'i thig le bya/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ spyi bor zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar pos rgyas btab pa'i mos pa gyis/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis dregs pa'i sku'i dbang thob pa yin pas deng phyin chad snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad dur khrod kyi dkyil 'khor g.yo ba bcud kyi sems can thams cad khrag 'thung chen po'i lha tshogs su shes par gyis shig /gsung gi dbang ni/ gnyis pa ni ye shes lha'i gsung gi nus pa bskyed par byed pa sngags kyi dbang bskur ba la/ dang po dzab bro brdung ba ste/ de yang khyed rang rnams sngon chad tshe rabs rnams su bsod nams rgya chen po bsags pas de'i mthus da lta gsang sngags bla med nye lam 'di lta bu dang mjal/ 'd-i'i sgor bzhugs pas 'bras bu bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen po yang dka' ba med par myur du 'grub par 'gyur ba 'di lta bu ni shin tu skal pa bzang ste/ de ltar go bas dga' spro'i bro brdung glu len byed pa ste/ khyed rang rnams dkyil 'khor chen po'i mtha' la bskor bzhin du brjid pa dpa' bo'i bro chen dgyes pa dpa' mo'i glu dbyangs 'di ltar sgrogs pa'i mos pa mdzod// sngon chad bsod nams bsags pa yis// bla med theg mchog 'di dang mjal// bde chen ngang nas sku bzhengs la// phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor gsal ba yi// sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po mchog /'bru brgyad sngags kyi bro chen brdungs// zhes bskul thams cad brgyan pas bzhengs// dkyil 'khor mtha' la bskor bzhin du// brjid pa dpa' bo'i bro chen dang*// dgyes pa dpa' mo'i glu dbyangs bstun/

/e myags ya rngubs mug shag ka dun hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐/ dang po'i sangs rgyas yin pa'i phyir// skye dang 'chi ba bya ba med// 'khor ba ye nas sangs rgyas te// ngan song gsum po lta bas bsgral// rnam rtog gdod nas chos sku yin// snang srid ma bcos phyag rgya'i zhing*// thams cad dregs pa'i lha tshogs la// 'bru brgyad sngags kyi mchod pa 'bul// thams cad grags stong ye shes te// gsung gi dngos grub chen po stsol// 'di ni ye shes chen po'i bro// 'khor 'das gnyis su med par brdung*// phyag rgya zil gnon mchog gi lam// lam 'di kun gyis thob gyur cig /ces brjod dus su/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i thugs ka nas drags sngags char bzhin du babs pa khyed rang rnams kyi ngag la thim par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyi snying gyen du kha phyogs pa'i snying tshil zla gdan/ snying rin po che zur brgyad pa'i nang du hūm̐ mthing nag /bla ma'i thugs ka'i sa bon las thugs kyi sngags phreng 'od zer mgal me 'khor ba lta bu 'thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal nas zhugs// snying ga'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar g.yas bskor du hram me 'dug pas rdo tshan la snum mi chags pa bzhin du yid kyi sgrib pa sbyangs ba'i thugs mos dang bcas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ a+ye myags ya rngubs mug shag ka dun hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ yang dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyi ljags kyi rtse mo las gsung gi sngags me'i tshwa tshwa lta bu 'phros pas khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par zhugs/ ngag gi sgrib pa dang sdig pa thams cad dag pa'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsung gi sngags ni lan gsum byin/ sku'i bu ga thams cad nas sku'i sngags 'ja' tshon lta bu 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyi bu ga thams cad nas zhugs/ lus kyi sgrib pa dang sdig pa thams cad dag pa'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/

oṃ e ka ya ma he dun rak+ṣa dun dun dza ya hūm̐ phaṭa// ces pa sku'i sngags ni lan gsum byin/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad dang slob dpon gyi gnas thams cad nas/ sngags phreng la la dkar po zhi bar byed pa'i nus pa can mgal me 'khor ba lta bu/ la la ser po sgro'i chun po lta bu rgyas par byed pa'i nus pa can/ la la dmar po lcags sgrog 'khyil ba lta bu dbang du byed pa'i nus pa can/ la la nag po me'i tshwa tshwa lta bu drag po dgra bgegs sgrol bar byed pa'i nus pa can sprin las char pa bzhin du thon pa khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum dang ro gcig tu gyur pas/ drag sngags kyi dbang thob pa'i mos pa gyis/ des ye shes kyi lha rnams kyi gsung gi dbang bskur ba song nas slar yang gsung rdo rje'i dngos grub brtan par bya ba'i ched du mgrin par dri'i thig le byas pas dngos grub brtan par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas rdo rjes mgrin par thig

/na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta wāk+ka badz+ra sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa la āḥdamar pos rgyas btab pas/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis drag po sngags kyi dbang thob pa yin pas ngag gi brjod pa thams cad sngags kyi sgrar shes par gyis shig /gsum pa thugs kyi nus pa ster bar byed pa la phyag mtshan gyi dbang bskur ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gyis/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kar zug /thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad phyag rgya dang mtshan ma'i rnam par char bzhin bab pa khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar thim pa'i mos pa gyis/ slob ma'i lag g.yas phyag mtshan gtad/ hūm̐/ 'khor ba sgrol byed 'khor lo dang*// nyon mongs gcod bye ral gri dang*// chos nyid mtshon pa'i rdo rje yis// sku gsung thugs kyi dbang thob shog /e ka ya ma tsakra khat+ga badz+ra yā hoḥ g.yon par gtad cing 'di skad du/ hūm̐/ be con dug lnga ye shes sgrol// gtun shing dgra bgegs 'dul bar byed// sdig mdzub bag chags bsdigs pa ste// rig pa'i dbang mchog thob par shog /e ka ya ma bhi sa hūm̐ ti ra hoḥ slar yang thugs rdo rje'i byin rlabs brtan par bya ba'i ched du snying gar dri'i thig le byas pas dngos grub brtan par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐ ti ra hoḥ / snying gar rdo rjes dri thig bya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig sngon pos rgyas btab pas/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis dregs pa thugs kyi dbang thob pa yin pas yid kyi rgyu ba thams cad chos nyid la chos nyid rol ba yin par shes par gyis shig / dkyil 'khor rdul tshon nam tshom bu/ de ltar ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du khyed rang rnams kyi lus la bum pa'i chos drug gi dbang bskur bas bum pa'i dbang thob/

byed pa lus kyi sgrib pa dag /lam bskyed rim bsgom la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku thob/ sku'i phrin las kyi sems can gyi don mdzad pa yin no// de ltar rnams kyis bum dbang mtha' brten dang bcas pa song nas/ da ni dbang gnyis pa gsang dbang la dngos gzhi byang sems kyis dbang bskur ba/ zhor du rak+ta gtor ma rgyan chas rnams dang tshe dbang tshogs kyi dbang bskur ba ste drug yod pa de rnams sngar ma thob pa mtshon pa'i phyir/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mig dar bcings/ gsang dbang zhu ba'i yon tan maṇ+ḍal/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ 'gyur med bde chen pho brang nas/ dregs pa'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol// dam tshig dka' thub sdom pa'i mchog /gsang ba'i sgron ma bdag la stsol// de ltar gyi gsol ba gdab pa song nas/ byang sems gyi dbang la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gyis bla ma yab yum bcom ldan 'das phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i tshe bdag yab yum du gsal ba'i gsang ba dang mkha' hūm̐ dang hrīḥlas skyes pa'i rdo rje dang pad+ma nor bu dang ze'u 'brur oṃ āḥs byin gyis brlabs pa 'dus byas snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bskul/ sku'i cha thams cad nas zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba 'khor lo bzhi'i lte bar babs/ dga' bzhi'i ye shes mngon du mdzad/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mo nas yum gyi rtsa kā ka mu kha'i sgor dkar dmar ro gcig tu 'dres par gyur/ rig pa'i stobs ldan sbyor ba'i mthus// 'khrul pa'i bag chags sprin gtor nas// ye shes nam mkha' gsal byed pa// gnyis med brtul zhugs chen po longs/ e ka ya ma pra tīts+tsha hoḥ bla mas de brjod slar gzungs mas/ 'di ste khrag 'thung yab yum gyi// dam tshig rmad byung chen po ste// khams lnga ldan pa'i ro rtogs byed// bde ba dam pa myong bar gyis//

bdud rtsi sbyin/ skye gnas byang sems gnang ba ste// a hoḥm hā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod de lce yis myang*/ mig dar dkrol/ rtogs can sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas// mgrin pa'i 'khor lo gtso bor gyur pa'i rtsa thams cad khyab/ skye gnas mthong bas lhag par bskul pa'i bde ba sgyu ma'i snang ba sna tshogs su gsal ba so so rang rig pa'i ngo bo nyid du byed par gyur/ de ltar byang sems kyi dbang bskur ba song nas/ gnyis pa dang gsum pa rak+ta dang gtor mas dbang bskur ba yin te/ de dag lag tu gtad pas khyed rang rnams kyis mchod pa'i tshogs kyi yan lag thams cad la dbang thob pa'i mos pa gyis/ hūm̐/ dwangs ma snying khrag bsgral ba sho na'i khrag / sogs/ e ka ya ma gu h+ya rak+ta bo dhi tsit+ta a bhi ṣits+tsha hoḥ rak+ta dang*/ hūm̐/ phyi snod 'jig rten khams kyi snod chen por// sogs/ e ka ya ma ba ling dz+nyā na pū dza a bhi ṣiñtsa ho// gtor mar bcas mchod pa'i tshig dbang bskur 'don pa bsgyur la bskur/ /des rak+ta dang gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba song nas/ bzhi pa rgyan chas kyis dbang bskur ba la/ khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon du gsal ba la chas dang rgyan rnams rim pa bzhin btags pa'i dang po thod phreng mgo la bkon pa'i mos pa gyis/ hūm̐/ thod pa tshar gsum phreng ba 'di// dug gsum sku gsum du bsgral nas// 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gyi// rgyal ba kun gyi dbang thob shog /mgo rlon do shal khyed rang rnams la sbyin pa'i mos pa gyis/ hūm̐/ khrag 'dzag mgo bo'i ga shal 'dis// sems byung ye shes su bsgral bas// khams gsum dbang du sdud pa dang*// srid gsum zil gyis gnon gyur cig /thal chen tshom bu dpral bar btab pa'i mos pa gyis/ hūm̐/ thal chen tshom bu 'di btab pas// thugs rje mtha' ru phyin pa'i dbang*// skye 'gro ma lus dbugs phyung nas// smin grol byed pa'i dbang thob shog

/mkhur 'dzum sna rtser khrag chen bsku ba'i mos pa gyis/ hūm̐/ rak+ta'i thig le 'di btab pas// thugs rje'i chags pa'i dbang nyid de// rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' bar// 'gro don byed pa'i dbang thob shog / zhag chen gyi zo ris btab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'dra ba gnyis 'dug /snying gar rtse gsum zhag gis bris pa bzhag pa'i mos pa gyis/ hūm̐/ zhag chen zo ris 'di btab pas// dam rdzas bcud kyi dbang mchog ste// sangs rgyas kun gyi byin rlabs kyis// skye 'chi med pa'i dbang thob shog /sbrul chun sked la bcings phyir sbyin pa'i mos pa gyis/ hūm̐/ sbrul nag chun po'i ske rags 'dis// zhe sdang rtsad nas gcod pa'i dbang*// na raka dmyal ba bsgral ba'i phyir// zhe sdang dag pa'i dbang thob shog /glang chen ko rlon stod g.yogs su bgyis pa'i mos pa gyis/ hūm̐/ glang chen ko rlon chen po 'di// theg pa chen po thob pa'i dbang*// ma lus de la gnas pa'i phyir// theg chen chos kyi dbang thob shog /zhing lpags g.yang gzhi sked par dkri ba'i mos pa gyis/ hūm̐/ zhing gi g.yang gzhi chen po 'di// gti mug rtsad nas gcod pa'i dbang*// tir ya ka ni bsgral ba'i phyir// gti mug dag pa'i dbang thob shog /stag gi shams thabs smad la dkris pa'i mos pa gyis/ hūm̐/ stag lpags sham thabs chen po 'di /phrin las rnam bzhi rdzogs pa'i dbang*// zhi rgyas dbang drag las bya'i phyir// thabs kyi don byed dbang thob shog /rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mos pa gyis/ hūm̐/ rus pa'i rgyan drug chen po 'di// 'dod chags rtsad nas gcod pa'i dbang*// pre ta ka ni bsgral ba'i phyir// 'dod chags dag pa'i dbang thob shog /de ltar rnam kyis chas kyi dbang bskur ba song nas/ lnga pa tshe'i dbang bskur ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gyis/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gru gsum pa'i nang du nyi ma 'og dang steng du zla ba kha sbyor ba'i gwa'u'i nang du tshe'i gzungs nri de'i gi gu/

na/ ra ta gsum las 'od dkar dmar mthing ga 'phros/ srid pa gsum gyi tshe srog thams cad bsdus nas de la thim/ 'od kyi thig le gcig tu gyur pa'i mos pa gyis/ hūm̐/ bkra shis brtan pa'i ga'u ru// mi 'gyur brtan pa'i tshe bskyil nas// rang rtags tshe yi dbang bskur bas// 'chi med tshe yi dbang thob shog /a+ye a+ye a+ye ya ma nṛ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ dzaḥ tshe yi lha mo bdud rtsir zhu nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor zhugs/ 'chi med tshe yi bdud rtsi'i lus dkar mer gyis gang ba'i mos pa gyis/ des tshe yi dbang bskur ba song nas/ de nas tshogs kyi dbang bskur ba la tshogs rdzas gtad pas tshogs kyi las la dbang ba'i mos pa gyis/ hūm̐/ 'chi med bdud rtsi rā sa na// bkra shis mtshan ldan lhag pa'i rdzas// 'phel 'grib med pa'i dbang bskur bas// rigs lnga ye shes dbang thob shog /'chi ba med pa zhal zas kyi dbang bskur bas mi zad pa'i gter la longs spyod pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig /de ltar dbang bskur ba rnams ni dkyil 'khor slob dpon gyi lus/ bskur yul khyed rnams kyi ngag la/ byang chub sems la sogs pa drug gi dbang bskur bas gsang ba'i dbang thob/ byed pa ngag gi sgrib pa dag /lam khyer rtsa rlung thig le bsgom pa la dbang*// 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob ste gsung gi phrin las kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa yin no// des dbang gnyis pa gsang dbang song nas dbang gsum pa shes rab ye shes la gsol ba 'debs pa/ spro ba 'dri ba gnyis/ de'i lan gdab pa/ thig le bya ba/ dri lan gdab pa/ phyag rgya gtad pa/ ye shes dbabs pa/ slob ma stong nyid du sbyangs pa/ lhar bskyed pa/ snyom par 'jug pa/ de'i don bshad pa ste bcu gnyis yod pa de rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal/ gsol ba gdab pa 'di yi rjes zlos gyis// bha ga gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// mnyam pa'i rgyal po dgongs su gsol/

dam tshig tshangs spyod sdom pa'i mchog /ye shes rol pa bdag la stsol// des dang po gsol 'debs song nas/ sher dbang sngar ma thob pa mtshon pa'i phyir/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes mig dar bcings/ de nas dang po gzungs ma la spro ba dri ba ni/ bha ga gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi// ye shes lhun gyis grub pa'i lhas// rigs kyi brtul zhugs sbyin byed pa// gzungs ma yid 'ong spro bar gyis// zhes dris par spro zhes khas blangs pa'i mos pa gyis/ de nas khyed rang rnams la spro ba dri ba ni/ 'di 'dra'i dkyil 'khor bla na med// yang dag gsang ba'i lam mchog ste// bu khyod skal pa rab tu gyur// 'di dang mjal la dga' ba skyed// de'i lan du gyur pa 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ bdag cag shin tu spro ba lags// dpa' bo chen po bka' drin che// de ltar rnams kyis spro ba dri ba gnyis lan bcas song nas/ thig le 'god pa ni/ las mkhan gyis gsung kyang da lam bdag gis bya ste gnas lngar byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa gyis/ ces slob ma'i gnas lngar thig le bkod/ des thig le bkod pa song nas tshig 'di ltar dri ste/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// bha ga'i gnas la longs spyod dang*// gzungs ma mtshan ldan rtag tu bsten// 'dod yon lnga la bde bar rol// gtsang dme ngo tsha'i rtog pa spongs// de ltar nus na brtul zhugs sbyin// de'i lan du gyur pa 'di'i rjes zlos gyis// dpa' bo chen pos bka' stsal ltar// bdag ni de ltar rjes su 'jug /des dam tshig dris lan song nas/ mig dar dbye/ dngos gzhi khyed rang rnams kyi lag g.yon du rig ma gtad de/ gcer bu bha ga rgyas par bstan pa'i mos pa gyis/ dus gsum sangs rgyas byon pa'i gnas// bde ba kun gyi 'byung gnas che// gnyis med cho gas snyoms zhugs nas// sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byos// des gtad pa song nas ye shes dbabs pa la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gyis/

khyed rang rnams 'od dpag med dang de'i mdun gyi nam mkhar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas par gsal ba las/ nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi thams cad 'od kyis dmar lam lam gyur pa'i mos pa gyis/ khyed rang rnams me long la has btab pa ltar 'od dpag med du gsal ba'i sku de je phra je phrar gyur te stong pa nyid du yal bar mos/ des sbyangs ba song nas lha bskyed snyoms 'jug la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du sgom cig /khyed rang rnams 'jam dpal phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i sku/ gzungs ma rdo rje khros ma rjes chags kyi sbyor bas bskul ba'i nang gi byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig 'dres pa'i rgyun gyis lus thams cad gang zhing dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes mngon du byas pas yum gyi bha ga'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs rnams mchod de thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i bde ba chen po'i ngo bor mnyes nas byang chub kyi sems thig ler zhu ba dung can gyi nang nas gyen du gshegs pas rim gyis phung po khams skye mched kyi snang ba thams cad sgyu ma lta bu'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor rang shar chos kyi dbyings bde stong lhan skyes kyi lha'i rol mor sad pa'i mos pa gyis/ des lhar bskyed pa dang snyoms par 'jug pa song nas/ rjes de'i don bshad pa ni/ 'di ni gsang ba'i theg mchog ste// ye shes bla na med pa'i don// rang byung ye shes 'di las thob// 'di las mchog tu gzhan med do// sbyor du bcug na de brjod do// dkyil 'khor shes rab ma'i bha ga /khyed rang rnams kyi yid la snyoms par 'jug pa'i ye shes kyis dbang bskur bas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ byed pa yid kyi sgrib pa dag /lam khyer pho nya sgom pa la dbang*// 'bras bu chos kyi sku thob ste thugs kyi phrin las kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa yin no// des gsum pa sher dbang song nas/

dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang ni/ mi rtog pa mtshon byed du bam gyi dbang bskur ba ste/ de la'ang rjes gnang gsol gdab/ bskyed bskur rgyas gdab/ bsgral ba dngos grub blang ba/ ngo sprod gzengs bstod dbugs dbyung ba rnams las/ dang po rjes gnang ni/ bdag nyid kyi/ hi hi zhes pa'i bzhad sgra yis// steng 'og phyogs mtshams ci snang ba// thams cad dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs// ma lus kun gyi nang na yang*// bla med zil gnon rngam pa'i sku// gnyis med rol pa'i cha lugs kyi// bde chen lhag pa'i nga ro 'byung*// mnyam pa'i brtul zhugs sbyin par bya'o// des rjes su gnang ba song nas/ gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo/ che ba'i nang nas che ba'i mchog /phyag btsal phyag rgya zil gnon la'o// mnyam nyid brtul zhugs chen po yis// bam chen rtogs med bde chen gang*// da lta nyid du ci nus phobasbrel// e ma ho/ ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ 'di 'dra'i theg chen bla na med// brtul zhugs da lta nyid du thob/ des rmad byung bshad nas/ des spro ba'i sems kyis gsol ba gdab pa song nas/ khyed rang rnams lhar bskyed cing dbang bskur ba gnyis la rim pa bzhin dmigs pa 'di ltar gyis/ hūm̐ mum̐/ rigs kyi bu khyed rang rnams 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gyis gnon pa'i nas gsar sgrigs bam snying ltar gyi dkyil 'khor chen por gsal bar gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon rtogs don bsdus/ dkyil 'khor gyi lhar skad cig gis gsal ba'i dam tshig sems dpa' la/ bam chen snying ga'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs kyi ye shes sems dpa' thams cad chil chil thim pas gnyis med bde ba chen po'i ngo bo gcig tu gyur pas ye shes bla na med pa'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa gyis/

rol sgra spod ngad ci li li// a+ye ring*/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ btags pa lan gsum bzlas/ des bam ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba song nas slar yang de rgyas btab pa'i phyir rdo rje'i phyag rgya'i rtse mos gnas gsum du dri'i thig le byas pas brtan par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ wāk+ka tsit+ta sngags sngar bzhin brjod/ des rgyas btab pa song nas bsgral bar bya ba'i phyir ral gri gtad pas 'dis bam dum bur gtub cig /hūm̐/ gshed chen mthu stobs yongs rdzogs las// dpag med phrin las mthar phyin zhing*// stong gsum srid pa zil mnan nas// snang srid skur sgrol dbang bskur ro// e ka he dun ya ma kro dha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de nas dngos grub len pa'i rim pa la dang po bam ro dum bur btub cing spung pa'i khar bdud rtsi'i ka pā la bzhag pa byin gyis rlabs pa bzhin bsgom par gyis// hūm̐/ thod dbus rigs lnga snyoms zhugs bdud rtsi zhu// nas/ hūm̐ hrīḥṭha/ bar bdud rtsi bzhin du byin gyis brlabs/ de nas de thams cad bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du skya mer gyis zhu ba la longs spyod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ a ho/ 'di ni ngo mtshar rmad kyi thabs// 'chi med rang byung bdud rtsi'i gter// longs spyod dag pas dbang bskur bas// thams cad rdzogs pa'i dbang thob shog / bdud rtsi sbyin/ de nas/ bam chen maṃ sas dbang bskur ba ni/ hūm̐/ mnyam pa nyid kyi brtul zhugs kyis/ nas/ bde chen mnyam nyid thob par shog /e ka ya ma a dhi pa ti ti ra hoḥ gtsang rme'i rtog pa med par mnyam nyid chen po'i ngang du rol pas lus thams cad zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsis skya mer gyis gang bas bde chen lhun gyis grub pa'i mchog gi skal pa can du gyur pa'o// bam ro dum bu byin/ zhes brjod chang dang sha la rol/ /des dngos grub len pa song nas slar de'i don ngo sprad pa ni 'di lta ste/

rang sems ma bcos pa'i ngang la bzhag pas chos nyid skye ba med pa kun bzang bde chen yangs pa'i klong na 'khor 'das 'dam ka med pa mnyam nyid chen por khyab gdal ba chos kyi sku da lta rang gi rig pa 'di kho na dbang bzhi pa yin no// 'dir dkyil 'khor rang byung gi ye shes chos nyid khyab gdal chen po de yang bam gyi rnam par mtshon te/ bam la rtog pa skad cig kyang med pa bzhin/ skye mched thams cad bkra lam mer snang ba ni dkyil 'khor gyi rang bzhin/ don rnam par mi rtog pas chos nyid yin pas so/ khyed rang rnams kyi kun gzhi'i rnam shes la rnam par mi rtog pa'i rdzas kyi dbang bskur bas dbang bzhi pa yang dag chos nyid mi rtog pa'i ye shes su thob/ byed pa shes sgrib dag lam khyer phyag rgya chen po de kho na nyid bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid rdo rje'i sku thob/ phrin las thams cad kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa ste/ rigs kyi bu khyed rnams de lta bu'i don dang ldan pas rgyud yongs su smin pa yin no// des gzengs bstod song nas gnyis pa dbugs dbyung ba ni/ de ltar dbang bzhi thob nas dam tshig ma nyams par lam bsnyen bsgrub rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas bsgrub na brtson 'grus can tshe gcig gis 'tshang rgya bas/ dman pa nyan rang ltar bskal pa grangs du mar dka' ba spyad mi dgos te lam mchog chen po'i skal pas dge ba yin no// dbug dbyungs ba song nas/ rjes kyi bya ba rdo rje slob dpon chen por dbang bskur ba la/ mthus dbang bskur ba dang*/ thun gyis dbang bskur ba dang*/ zor gyis dbang bskur ba ste bzhi yi dang po slob dpon du dbang bskur ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gyis/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba'i 'og tu seṅge'i khri/ steng du gdugs/ rkang par 'khor lo/ khar dung*/ lag par rgyud kyi gleg bam rnams gtad pa'i mos pa gyis/ phyag rgya chen po'i dkyil 'khor du// khyed kyi dbang rnams rdzogs par thob/

da ni khyed kyis slob dpon gyis/ slob ma smin cing grol bar mdzod/ des slob dpon du dbang bskur ba song nas/ gnyis pa mngon spyod kyi mthu yi dbang ni/ gzhung las/ brub khung thod nang liṅga bcug /phur bus btab cing mtshon gyis gtub// zhes gsungs pa ltar la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ brub khung yangs shing sogs/ da lam rgyas par bya ste/ der dbang phyir/ dang po khyed rang rnams la bsgral chas gtad pas/ drag po mngon spyod kyi las thams cad la dbang ba'i mos pa gyis/ hūm̐/ gdug pa can gyi dgra bgegs la// snying rjes ma rungs sems can ni// phrin las drag pos bsgral ba'i phyir// mngon spyod mthu yi dbang bskur ro// bsgral chas gtad/ dgra bo mā ra ya a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ bsgral las bya/ de rnams kyis drag po mngon spyod kyi dbang bskur ba song nas/ gsum pa thun gyi dbang bskur ba la khyed rang rnams kyi lag pa g.yas su thun dang g.yon du phreng ba gtad pa ni/ hūm̐/ drag po sngags kyi dbang thob nas/ dgra bgegs gdug pa 'joms pa'i phyir// gzi byin bskyed pa'i thun dang ni// bgrang phreng rak+ṣa'i dbang bskur ro// e ka he dun trag rak+ṣa ya ma rā tsa sa do me ya/ ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni/ ra ya k+ṣe ya/ yak+ṣe ya tsa ni ra ma ya dgra bo a+ye myags ya rngubs mug shag ka dun bh+yo ṇi hur thuṃ dza mā ra ya rbad a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ ces gtad/ des thun gyi dbang bskur ba song nas/ zor gyis dbang bskur ba la zor rdzas rnams lag tu gtad pas 'phen pa'i las rab 'byams la dbang thob pa'i mos pa gyis/ hūm̐/ thabs shes nus pa mthar phyin nas// byad ma rdul du brlag pa la// nga rgyal chen pos 'phen byed pa'i// zor rdzas rnams kyi dbang thob shog /e ka he dun bh+yo bzlog /ya ma rā tsa bh+yo bzlog /ma mo e ka dza ṭi bh+yo bzlog mā ra ya bzlog /ma mo e ka tsa ti thun bh+yo bzlog /phu sa na ga gtad khroṃ bh+yo bzlog phyung phyung*/

shig shig /khrol khrol/ mā ra ya s+t+waṃ bha ya laṃ nan/ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ des zor dbang bskur ba ste/ de ltar rnams kyis rigs kyi bu khyed rnams kyis phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang yongs su rdzogs par thob kyis deng phyin chad bskyed rdzogs bsnyen bsgrub legs par gyis la 'di'i sgo nas dbang dang byin rlabs 'chad nyan dang gdug pa can la drag po'i phrin las la sogs pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa mdzod cig / zhes brjod slob mas 'di skad zhu/ de ltar gdams pa rnams khas len pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ dpa' bo chen po'i bka' bzhin du// sems can don la brtson par bgyi// bla ma'i sku chu lha tshogs der// nya ldang 'dra bsam yon phul la// tshogs la rol zhing las kyi rjes// skabs dang bstun te bsdu bar bya// sgrub rdzogs rdzas kyi dngos grub blang*// lus bsrung rdul tshon chu bor drangs// zhes gsungs pa'i rim pa rnams ni sgrub pa chen po'i spyi'i 'gros bzhin bya'o// de ltar snying gzer nag po'i dkyil chog khrag 'thung rol pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje nyid las chos thams cad ci dgar spyod pa'i lung thob pa kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar pos/ rgyud dang man ngag /gnub sangs rgyas ye shes la sogs pa'i lung 'thor ba gcig tu bsdus nas skal ldan 'jug pa bde bar bgyis pa 'di yang cung zad bsdus drag par mtshams sbyor rnams gsal du bkral ba zhig dgos zhes dge bshes bstan 'dzin phun tshogs kyis bskul ngor/ ngag dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin gyis dmar mchan btab dang gzhan du zhal 'phen gnang ba rnams ji lta bar dkyus su/ yi ge khrigs su sdebs pa bskul pa po nyid dang mchod dpon bid+yā dha kār+ya gnyis kyis ma nor bar bsgrig pa yi ger btab pa'i dge bas kun kyang 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig
/bkra shis zhal gro/ dge'o/
